name: s481
signature: int s481(int *a, const int *b, const int *c, const int *d, int n)

contract.execution: One execution of the original repetition-loop body, including local setup.
contract.aliasing: Distinct array arguments must have non-overlapping storage, matching the original globals. No restrict qualifier is added.
contract.arithmetic: Every evaluated signed arithmetic expression must be representable as int. Signed overflow is not defined as wraparound.
contract.memory: All array arguments are valid initialized buffers, also when n=0. No alignment beyond int alignment is required.
contract.empty_input: No array writes; return -1 (completed without a stop).
contract.notes: API adaptation, not process equivalence: replace exit(0) with the first negative d index; return -1 on completion. Test the stop before updating a[i]; preserve the stop element and suffix.

termination.return_on_stop: zero-based index of the first negative d element, before its update
termination.preserved_state: updated prefix and untouched stop element/suffix

adaptations: remove harness and execute one computational repetition
replace process exit(0) with an observable stop index; -1 means completed
expose termination's scalar observation as the return value

experiment_caveats.aggregate_policy: report separately; do not silently pool with ordinary integer kernels

testing.description: Exercise no stop and first/middle/last stop positions independently of data trials; use mixed-sign data before and after the stop.
